item.title: fix(cron): reject blank agent and session flags (#119879)
item.summary: fix(cron): reject blank agent and session flags (#119879) Reject empty or whitespace-only `--agent` and `--session-key` values for cron edit, including value/clear mutex cases, while preserving clear and omitted behavior. Fixes #119878.
